items.title: Bind carried non-mechanical provenance to the unchanged evidence identity
items.context: carryForwardOnDiskProvenance currently preserves mechanical:false and nonMechanicalReason by intentRef alone, allowing a changed command/result row to inherit an unrelated prior attestation. Preserve legitimate metadata-only re-persistence, but drop stale provenance and reject executable rows when evidence identity changes.

items.title: Synchronize acceptance coverage-basis temporary repositories with the registered closure inventory
items.context: proofstory-acceptance-basis-smoke, proofstory-acceptance-topology-gate-smoke, and proofstory-topology-critic-smoke omit current pre-review and/or Wave 4 rollout producer source refs, so snapshot sealing correctly returns partial before the intended assertions execute. Repair fixtures without bypassing snapshot sealing or removing registry obligations.

items.title: Prove all four focused regressions exercise their intended production failures and restored controls
items.context: Run the real negative controls: changed-command attestation must be refused; complete fixture controls must seal complete; topology/basis/critic mutations must still fail closed; restored controls must pass. Do not replace semantic assertions with weaker output checks.

items.title: Add a bounded routine validation entry that prevents these focused tests from silently rotting
items.context: The default npm test chain currently omits these focused tasks, and topology-gate/critic lack package scripts. Add a bounded non-duplicative validation surface that runs the four tests without triggering duplicate full rollout cohorts, and retain build/process-fact/pre-review compatibility.
